context: Tenant canvass at an Eighth Ave hotel (Act 3).

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: Tenants' petition. The march is the twenty-third. Will you sign?

lines.speaker: npc.sro_resident
lines.text: You were police. I remember you. …You're asking, not taking? Huh.

lines.speaker: npc.sro_resident
lines.text: Merchant seaman, thirty years. Ships to everywhere. I'll sign.

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: Thank you. Bring a chair on the twenty-third.
